title.rendered: The 24-25 School Supply List is Now Available!

content.rendered:
Listed below are the imperative school supplies students need when they attend SMS.  Teachers have purchased most other supplies and those are available for student use.  Of course, students are always welcome to buy supplies to keep independently if they prefer to do so.

Each Student Needs:

  • Pencils (and LOTS of them)
  • Binder/folders to hold papers going to and from school each day
  • Personal novel
  • Refillable water bottle

Additionally, students will need the following supplies by course subject:

Language Arts:

  • Composition notebook
  • Post-it note package

Social Studies:

  • 6th grade: composition notebook (college ruled preferred)
  • 7th & 8th grade: spiral notebook
  • Glue sticks

Math:

  • Composition or spiral notebook
  • T1-30 calculator (or something similar)
  • 6th grade: Scotch tape, glue sticks

Science:

  • Composition or spiral notebook

PE:

  • Shorts and a t-shirt appropriate for activities
  • Athletic shoes

School Wide Support:

  • Pencils
  • Clorox wipes
  • Boxes of Kleenex
  • Hand Sanitizer
  • Highlighters
  • Post-it notes
